import pandas as pd

def parse_money(values):
    """Convert a Series of text like ' $1,234.50' to floats.
    Values that cannot be converted become NaN."""
    cleaned = (
        values.astype("string")
        .str.strip()
        .str.replace("$", "", regex=False)
        .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
    )
    return pd.to_numeric(cleaned, errors="coerce")


messy = pd.read_csv("orders_messy.csv")

messy["total"] = parse_money(messy["total"])
total_sum = round(float(messy["total"].sum()), 2)
over_200 = int((messy["total"] > 200).sum())
